MW2012 FPS Unlock
=================

Frame rate unlock with motion interpolation and a borderless window mode for Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2012), NFS13.exe v1.5.

Install: copy everything in this archive into the game folder (the one containing NFS13.exe) and let Windows merge the "scripts" folder. Start the game normally.

Settings: scripts\MW2012FpsUnlock.ini (every option is explained inside).

Uninstall: delete dinput8.dll and the files this archive put into "scripts".

Problems: attach scripts\MW2012FpsUnlock.log (or %TEMP%\MW2012FpsUnlock.log for an install under Program Files; the previous session's log is kept as MW2012FpsUnlock.log.old) to an issue at https://github.com/Krashgamer/NFSMW2012FpsUnlock/issues

License: MIT, see scripts\MW2012FpsUnlock-LICENSE.txt.
dinput8.dll is Ultimate ASI Loader by ThirteenAG, MIT, see scripts\Ultimate-ASI-Loader-LICENSE.txt.
